editorNote: Rocket Lab's stock kept climbing on a fresh launch contract rather than a single mission win, while Alphabet's DeepMind quietly dismantled the team behind its Nobel-winning AlphaFold work as it refocuses on Gemini. Bitcoin holders got a reminder that hardware wallets aren't infallible after a Coldcard flaw let attackers drain roughly $40M, gold gave back some of July's gain as the yen weakened on a Bank of Japan hold, and Duolingo leaned into marketing rather than fundamentals with a Luckin Coffee tie-up.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab signs its third iQPS multi-launch deal in a year, stock up over 9%
stories.summary: Rocket Lab will fly three more dedicated Electron missions for Japan's iQPS starting late 2027, each deploying a QPS-SAR satellite to a 575km orbit, bringing iQPS's total booked Electron launches to 18. Shares gained 9.39% on the announcement.
stories.whyItMatters: It's the third multi-launch booking from the same customer within a year, a sign of repeat-buyer demand for Electron beyond one-off contracts.

sourceLinks.title: Rocket Lab Signs 3-Launch iQPS Deal for Late 2027
Why Rocket Lab Stock Is Soaring Today

stories.headline: Coldcard hardware-wallet flaw drains roughly $40M in bitcoin from hundreds of wallets
stories.summary: Attackers exploited predictable software-based key generation on Coldcard Mk3 devices running firmware from March 2021 onward, draining about 600 BTC (~$40M) from hundreds of separate wallets within minutes. Maker Coinkite says it was unaware of the bug until the attack surfaced and is telling users to migrate funds to new wallets.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin held above $60,000 despite the news, but a flaw in a widely-used cold-storage device undercuts the core promise of hardware wallets as attackers race to exploit it before users can move funds.

sourceLinks.title: Massive, Surprise Bitcoin Attack Sparks Sudden Price Crash Fears

stories.headline: Google DeepMind disbands the team behind its Nobel-winning AlphaFold work
stories.summary: DeepMind has dissolved the dedicated AlphaFold team, reassigning most of its researchers to Gemini and other projects as the company shifts from single-problem teams toward a Gemini-centered structure; VP Pushmeet Kohli said 'the strategy has evolved.' Nobel laureate John Jumper left for Anthropic in June along with two other core co-authors, and nearly a quarter of the original paper's full-time authors have now left Google entirely.
stories.whyItMatters: The AlphaFold database and server keep running, but active development of one of DeepMind's flagship scientific breakthroughs has been folded into the broader Gemini push rather than continued as a dedicated effort.

sourceLinks.title: Google DeepMind disbands its Nobel-prize winning AlphaFold team

stories.headline: Gold slips to $4,076 as a Bank of Japan rate hold strengthens the dollar
stories.summary: Gold fell about 0.5% to $4,076.53 after the Bank of Japan held rates at 1% on an 8-1 vote, weakening the yen and lifting the dollar, which makes dollar-priced gold costlier for international buyers. Gold is still tracking a 1.8% gain for July, its first monthly rise in five months, helped by 289 tonnes of central-bank buying in Q2.
stories.whyItMatters: The pullback shows gold's rally is still sensitive to currency and rate moves even as central-bank demand provides an underlying floor.

sourceLinks.title: Why Is Gold Price Down Today? XAU/USD Slips to $4,077 as BoJ Holds Rates at 1%

stories.headline: Duolingo teams up with Luckin Coffee for a US back-to-school drink collaboration
stories.summary: Duolingo and Luckin Coffee launched a limited-time US collaboration pairing co-branded beverages (including two new drinks) with merchandise across a summer-learning and back-to-school campaign, Luckin's first collaboration in the US market.
stories.whyItMatters: It's a marketing push aimed at Duolingo's core Gen Z user base rather than a change to the business itself, ahead of the company's August 5 earnings report.

sourceLinks.title: Luckin Coffee and Duolingo Team Up for a Limited-Time Collaboration Celebrating Summer Learning and Back-to-School
